title: ACCORD Project Configuration
description: Stack-specific configuration for the /dev ACCORD workflow, embedded in a project's AGENTS.md under the ## Dev Harness compatibility heading as a fenced JSON block.

language.description: Primary language — e.g. typescript, python, go, rust, ruby, java, csharp

detect_file.description: Marker file that identifies this stack — e.g. go.mod, Cargo.toml, package.json, pyproject.toml

command.description: Full test suite command — e.g. go test ./..., pytest, cargo test, vitest run

single_test_flag.description: Flag to run a single named test — e.g. -run (Go), -k (pytest), -t (vitest/jest)

file_pattern.description: Glob for test files — e.g. *_test.go, *.test.ts, test_*.py

block_markers.description: Test block declaration patterns for grep — e.g. func Test, def test_, describe(, it(

type_check.description: Type/static-analysis command — e.g. go vet ./..., mypy ., cargo check, tsc --noEmit. null when the language has no separate type-check step.

lint.description: Linter command — e.g. golangci-lint run, ruff check, cargo clippy. null to skip.

format.description: Format-check command — e.g. gofmt -l, ruff format --check, cargo fmt --check. null to skip.

verification_commands.description: Default verification commands for specs in this project. Seeded into spec.verification.commands during /dev spec.

tracker.description: Issue tracker configuration. Determines how phase-gather fetches ticket context. Defaults to jira if omitted.

type.description: Tracker provider name. Must match a bundled provider (jira, github, gitlab, plain-text) or a user-defined one declared in the top-level `providers` array.

project_prefix.description: Expected work item ID prefix — e.g. STEP, ENG, PROJ. Used for ID validation and inference.

log_level.description: ACCORD diagnostic log level. Logs go to stderr prefixed [accord:<tag>:<level>]. Override at runtime with ACCORD_LOG_LEVEL env var.

providers.description: User-defined provider declarations. Each entry adds (or overrides) a tracker or enrichment provider. Bundled providers from assets/providers/ are always available; entries here let projects swap a playbook, point at a custom MCP/CLI/env tool, or add an entirely new provider. See schemas/provider-schema.json for the per-entry shape.

promptFile.description: Absolute path (or ~/-prefixed path) to the markdown fetch playbook for this provider.

context_sources.description: Project-level enrichment source overrides. Merged on top of global accord.json sources (matched by type). Use enabled:false to disable a global source for this project.

type.description: Enrichment source name. Must match a bundled enrichment provider or a user-defined one declared in the top-level `providers` array.

enabled.description: Set false to disable a globally-enabled source for this project.

channels.description: Slack channels to scope keyword search to.

base_url.description: Service base URL override for this project.

tool.description: Workspace tool — e.g. nx, turbo, cargo workspaces, go workspaces, pnpm workspaces, lerna

root.description: Path to monorepo root relative to this AGENTS.md

quick_fix_loop.description: Quick-fix adversarial test↔review loop: after each validated `review-test` packet, the harness may bump counters, set task `phase` to `phase-test` or `phase-code`, or mark the task `blocked` when the cap is reached.

max_test_review_loops.description: Maximum `test_review_cycles_used` before further gated `issues` verdicts block the task. Default: 5.

severity_gate.description: `none`: any `issues` verdict can consume a retry. `warn`: warning or critical findings consume a retry. `block`: only critical findings consume a retry. Default: warn.

implement_loop.description: Standard **implement** pipeline: after validated `phase-code`, the harness may set task `phase` to **review-code** when the plan marks `challenge` or the return packet requests reviews.

code_review_on_challenge.description: When true (default), a plan task with `challenge: true` routes to **review-code** after `phase-code` completes successfully.

code_review_on_reviews_requested.description: When true (default), a `phase-code` return with `reviews_requested` > 0 routes to **review-code**.

judgment.description: Optional bounded LLM step that appends a schema-validated brief fragment to resume task text (Phase 5). Requires `ACCORD_ORCHESTRATION_JUDGMENT=1` on Pi to call the model.

enabled.description: When true, eligible resume spawns may call judgment before subagent execution (Pi only when env gate is set).

agents.description: Dispatch agent ids (registry) that receive judgment. Default: review-test, phase-test.

max_tokens.description: Max output tokens for the judgment completion. Default: 1536.
